title: {Syn} CLIP Connected Images and Text at Web Scale
content:
CLIP learned visual representations by matching images with their text captions. That contrastive setup made zero-shot image classification surprisingly effective.

The model also became an important building block for text-to-image systems and image retrieval because it embeds language and vision into a shared space.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
